fields.acceptance: A testscript gets exit 2 with the next from rhiza request in an unregistered repo and in a repo under no root ($NOROOT, from testscripts-run-under-root), and runs rhiza check there successfully; the existing run start and request scripts pass under the Setup root.
fields.statement: Starting a run or queuing a request (rhiza run start, rhiza request) needs a registered project under a root and otherwise exits 2 with a next naming rhiza root init or rhiza project add; model commands (show, apply, check, render, land) keep working in any repo with .rhiza/, so CI needs no root.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(run-start|run-start-queue|daemon-settings|daemon-pause|daemon-event-hook|daemon-repo-session|stage-autonomy)$' passes with runs-need-root and root-daemon-lock in force and those scripts unedited; a script running rhiza root show in $WORK sees its own project, and in $NOROOT gets exit 2 naming rhiza root init.
fields.statement: The testscript Setup in cmd/rhiza/main_test.go puts every script under a Rhiza root: before the scripts run it writes a rhiza.toml in the scripts' shared work root registering each script's $WORK folder as a project, so the existing scripts that start runs, queue requests or run the daemon in a bare $WORK repo keep passing unchanged, and it gives scripts a folder outside any root ($NOROOT) for the outside-a-root cases.
